comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Alright, alright — Airport run! Leh we go!
Buckle up, star — Jamaican road nuh play!
road.enter: Welcome to {road} — mind how yuh drive!
pothole.burst: Lawd — dat pothole nearly swallow di whole car!
Yuh see how dem nuh fix di road?! Smh.
tyre.fixed: Good good, back on di road now!
Roadside mechanic save di day, respect!
dog.chase: Watch di dawg, star! Him nuh 'fraid!
Rahtid! Di dawg dem a run yuh dung!
Lawd have mercy, di dawg dem bad bad!
Kingston dawg nuh normal — dem look both ways before dem chase yuh!
goat.hit: Yuh lick down di man goat! Him nuh cheap yuh know!
Weh yuh a do?! Di goat dem innocent!
Brethren, dat nuh right — di poor goat!
Ayyy! Farmer ago vex wid yuh still!
score.milestone.first: Yuh start move now! Keep it up, star!
score.milestone.halfway: Halfway through, and yuh still inna one piece! Respect!
Half di journey done — di hill country coming up now!
score.goats.spared: Yuh dodge all di goat dem — big respect fi dat!
Goat herder love yuh today, star!
speed.fast: Easy nuh, brethren — dis nuh race track!
Yuh a fly — slow down before di police catch yuh!
Wooiee! Yuh serious bout dis ting!
faiths.pen: Faith's Pen, star! Best jerk chicken inna Jamaica right here!
Pull over nuh — di festival and roast yam calling yuh!
arrive.ochi: Ocho Rios! Yuh mek it, brethren — di journey done!
Dunn's River calling — time fi cool off inna di waterfall!
Ochi Rios massive! Welcome to di north coast, star!
